title: Lower Bounds for Anytime Acceleration of Gradient Descent
summary: Recent work suggests that the convergence rate of gradient descent (GD) in smooth convex optimization can be significantly improved by employing large stepsizes that may violate the descent property. In particular, if the total number of iterations $n$ is given, an $O(n^{-1.271})$ convergence rate can be achieved for both function value and squared gradient norm minimization.
